svg.title: AirDial: switch desktops gesture
svg.desc: A person swipes an open palm to the right in front of the MacBook camera; the monitor slides over to the desktop on the left. Swiping left goes to the desktop on the right.
svg.text: palm → right = the desktop on the left (and vice versa)
🖐 Swipe your open palm sideways — switch desktops
